title: The Arithmetic of Shapes
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: Krishnamurti turns shape arithmetic into algorithms: combine line content, remove it, keep common intervals, test parthood and compare shapes. The emphasis is choosing a representation that makes geometric coverage computable.
prerequisites: Elementary sets and functions; some proof reading

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

verification.scope: Author-hosted original inspected for rational coordinates, line representation, Boolean algorithms and data structures; printed pp. 470–471 also checked as page images. The pseudocode was read for its structure, not independently implemented or formally verified. Operation-count bounds are not modern machine benchmarks.
